subject: Quarter kickoff: anchor OKRs, confirm owners, and QBR packet request
messages:
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom@acme.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quarter kickoff: anchor OKRs, confirm owners, and QBR packet request

Team —

As we ramp into Q2 planning, I want to lock down a minimal set of cross-org OKRs we’ll use for the kickoff and for the QBR with Acme on 4/05. Goals here are to:

- Anchor 3 mission-level OKRs (customer outcomes, reliability/cost, and platform adoption).
- Confirm owners and 0/1/2 top-level metrics per OKR.
- Finalize the QBR packet template and customer-specific slides for Acme.

I attached a first-pass OKR frame (Q1_OKR_frame_v1.pptx) and the QBR packet template. Can each of you respond with: owner name, primary metric (and calculation), and one dependency we need to resolve by 3/30? Examples below.

- Platform Adoption (owner:) — metric: MAU using Redwood SDK (monthly active customers) — dependency: onboarding docs & SDK v0.9 rollout
- Reliability & Cost (owner:) — metric: p99 latency and $/M tokens served — dependency: staging autoscaler tuning

Also looped Nina/Tom from Acme — Nina, if you can share the two slides you want in the packet (CS health + integrations roadmap) by 3/25 that would help.

Thanks — aiming to publish the finalized OKR doc and QBR deck by 3/31 so executive sign-off can happen the week after.

Best,
David
David Kim
VP Product, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q1_OKR_frame_v1.pptx (pptx, 2.1MB), QBR_packet_template.docx (docx, 320KB)

Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff: anchor OKRs, confirm owners, and QBR packet request

Thanks, David — quick take below. I annotated your deck and included suggested owners inline (attached annotated PPT). High level:

- Customer Outcomes (owner: Mina Haddad) — metric: Net Promoter Score (NPS) for P0 accounts and expansion rate for pilot customers. Dependency: finalize the evaluation prompt set we use for MQA checks (blocking for accuracy baseline).
- Reliability & Cost (owner: Karthik Iyer) — metrics: p99 < 220ms, $/1M tokens reduced by 15% QoQ. Dependency: apply the new batching config to dedicated pools.
- Platform Adoption (owner: Laura Bennett) — metric: number of production services using streaming API (count), convert-to-paid rate for sandbox signups. Dependency: update onboarding template and add sample guards.

Two asks:
1) Karthik — can you confirm the ETA for autoscaler tuning and whether it needs infra support (we have SRE capacity hit on 3/28).
2) Mina — please draft the Acme-specific slide content for CS health; Nina should have the acme-side numbers, but we can template the slide.

TL;DR: I’m good to be owner for Platform Adoption.

Laura Bennett
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Quick update from infra side:
- Autoscaler tuning: prototype landed in staging 3/14; safe rollout to dedicated pools can start 3/25 but will need SRE guardrails (canary + traffic cap). I estimate full rollout to medium pools by 3/30 if no regressions.
- Batching config: new defaults reduce per-token GPU time by ~8% in our synthetic tests; we should plan a canary on the Acme reserved pool before 3/30.

Dependency answer: yes, SRE support required for canary window 3/25–3/30. Grace — can you confirm SRE booking?
